summary: Restored per-request spec_draft and spec_verify timing on the active EAGLE V2, multi-layer EAGLE V2, and NGRAM paths. Verify completion is shared by both EAGLE workers and converts accept_lens (which includes the bonus token) to drafts-only num_correct_drafts only when tracing is enabled. The removed spec_draft_extend request stage remains removed. A related upstream fix exists as open PR https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/37352, but neither the recorded base nor mirror main contained it.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before regression: all five tests failed because production verify-close support and EAGLE/NGRAM request-tracing call sites were absent. Raw output: reports/j-4ac7fa9d9f8a/raw/regression-before.txt

11 CPU tests passed: restored worker call sites, drafts-only count mapping, one timestamp per batch, and no device read or request mutation when tracing is disabled or the batch is empty. Raw output: reports/j-4ac7fa9d9f8a/raw/focused-tests.txt

On the assigned AMD Instinct MI350X (gfx950), a real device int32 accept_lens tensor [3, 1, 4] produced per-request drafts-only trace counts [2, 0, 3]. Raw output: reports/j-4ac7fa9d9f8a/raw/gpu-helper-check.txt

tests.command: /opt/venv/bin/pre-commit run ruff and ruff-format on changed Python files; git diff --check
tests.what_was_measured: Changed Python sources and regression tests pass repository lint/format checks and contain no whitespace errors. Raw output: reports/j-4ac7fa9d9f8a/raw/lint.txt

gpu_execution.evidence: A single assigned gfx950 GPU reported as AMD Instinct MI350X executed the trace-only device-to-host acceptance-count conversion; [3, 1, 4] mapped to [2, 0, 3]. This was not a model-serving reproduction.

remaining_limitations: No EAGLE or NGRAM model weights were provided, so no live serving/exporter trace was produced.
The GPU check validates the exact device-tensor conversion used by the fix, not model architecture behavior, semantic accuracy, multi-GPU execution, or multi-node execution.
The deliberately removed spec_draft_extend RequestStage was not reintroduced.
